name: queries-in-one-step
description: One advance holds many conditions, each a query whose answer is not yet known. Each query halts the step once, and the evaluation goes on from where it halted, not from the first condition again (engine §4).
head:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text 'a'
%conditions

name: queries-in-one-term
description: One tag term is a union of many queries. Each query halts the evaluation once, and the union goes on from the part where it halted, keeping the parts it has (engine §4).
head:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text 'a' <
